name: SOC-A01-Broken-Access-Control
description: OWASP A01:2021 — Auto-respond to privilege escalation and unauthorized access detected by Tetragon eBPF or Suricata. Logs alert, notifies SOC L1, and records CVE/CWE for patching.

parameters.name: call
parameters.value: OWASP A01 ALERT: $exec.owasp_id | CVE: $exec.cve | CWE: $exec.cwe | SRC: $exec.src_ip | NIST: $exec.nist_iso_controls

parameters.name: call
parameters.value:
SOC-L1 ACTION REQUIRED:
Threat: $exec.owasp_name
Source IP: $exec.src_ip
CVE: $exec.cve
MITRE: $exec.mitre_mitigation
Patch Steps: $exec.patch_steps

parameters.name: info
parameters.value: Receives CVE/OWASP enriched alerts from SOC ML Engine
